title: Bharat Ane Nenu
desc: Bharat, a graduate from Oxford, is forced to take up his father's position as the chief minister after his sudden death. He tries to reform the corrupt society but faces obstacles from his enemies.

title: Meeku Maathrame Cheptha
desc: Rakesh lies to his fiancé about various aspects of his life. However, chaos ensues when a shocking video of him leaks just two days before their wedding.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Aadikeshava
desc: Following the death of his biological father, a man travels to Rayalaseema to protect his sister and his ancestral temple.

title: Hello Brother
desc: Twins Deva and Ravi Verma are separated at birth by a goon named Misro. Later, they reunite to defeat Mitra, the son of Misro and a miscreant, who seeks revenge against their father, Chakravarthy.

title: Prema Khaidi
desc: Chandram and Neelima, a young couple, face troubles since her father, Bapineedu, does not approve of her choice as he belongs to a poor family.

title: Fun Time
desc: A fun-filled show featuring the best comedy moments from the latest Tollywood films, delivering nonstop laughter and light-hearted entertainment.

title: Om
desc: After thwarting the enemy's plans to kill his father Harishchandra, Arjun learns a shocking truth that turns his life upside-down.

title: Pavithra Prema
desc: Manickam locks horns with Ghata Ratthaiah, a corporator, who exploits the public. Shakuntala, a doctor, helps Manickam, unaware that he had raped her in an intoxicated state.

title: Lucky Bhaskar
desc: A struggling bank teller takes a chance on a shady investment scheme with an unproven partner. Later, as his fortunes rise, so does his ego, driving him to take on increasingly reckless risks.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Mr. X
desc: A renegade operative competes with the clock to prevent a nuclear disaster.
